predecessors.name: Linear Pottery culture
predecessors.text: the Dniester lands of the LBK's eastern extension

ledger.x: 4800 BCE: the painted-pottery villages of Cucuteni-Trypillia rise between the Carpathians and the Dniester.
4100 BCE: the middle phase and the mega-sites of the Southern Bug and Dnieper.
3500 BCE: the Late period (Horodiștea-Foltești, Trypillia CII), "3500 to 3000 BC" in the page's chart.
3000 BCE: the culture ends under the Kurgan expansion.

certainty.note: An archaeological culture drawn by modern units: the Carpathian edge is firm, the steppe edge toward the Dnieper and the Black Sea is soft.
